lines: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - (FAQ) - Expansion Of Service Tax Scope 2025

Sales Tax (Imposition Of Sales Tax In Respect Of Designated Areas) (Amendment) Order 2025
Service Tax (Imposition Of Tax For Taxable Service In Respect Of Designated Areas Excluding Pulau 1 And Special Areas) (Amendment) Order 2026
Ketetapan Umum Bil. 6/2026 - Borang, Penyata, Cara Permohonan Dan Kaedah Bayaran Di Bawah Akta Cukai Pelancongan 2017, Akta Cukai Jualan 2018 Dan Akta Cukai Perkhidmatan 2018

The MySST system is a sales and service tax management system. Sales tax is a single stage tax imposed and levied on taxable goods manufactured in Malaysia by registered persons and sold by them (including disposal and own use) and on the importation of taxable goods into Malaysia. Meanwhile, Service tax is a tax charged and levied on taxable services provided by any taxable person in Malaysia in the course and furtherance of business. Service tax also include imported taxable services by any person into Malaysia for the purpose of business.

The MySST system was first launched on August 6, 2018, following the implementation of the Sales Tax Act 2018 and Service Tax Act 2018, replacing the Goods and Services Tax Act 2015 (GST), which came into effect on September 1, 2018.

Starting from 1 July 2025, Malaysia’s Sales and Service Tax (SST) framework will be updated to broaden the tax base. This enhancement is part of the government’s effort to strengthen the country’s indirect tax system and ensure long-term revenue sustainability.
